name: package-only-unread-node-command
description: A package whose only Node evidence would be a script that runs node, here behind env --frobnicate, holds none for program.36, which reads no script: its JavaScript resolves as a bundler does, so the extensionless relative specifier names its file and raises no unresolved-specifier note. The script names index.js as a token, which roots it, so the manifest raises no unread-command note.
